analyst.summary: Nykaa is India's largest online beauty retailer and enters FY27 with real momentum: FY26 revenue crossed Rs.10,000 crore (+26% YoY), profit nearly tripled to Rs.204 crore, and the Fashion business turned EBITDA-positive for the first time. Early management guidance for the June-2026 quarter points to close to 30% revenue growth, the strongest in three years. The catch is valuation - the stock trades near 460-470 times trailing earnings against a still-modest 6% return on equity, so the price already assumes several years of near-flawless execution, at the same time as competition from Reliance's Tira, Myntra's beauty push, Purplle, and quick-commerce apps is intensifying. We rate it Hold: the business is executing well, but there is very little valuation cushion if growth or margins disappoint even briefly.
